01 / PORTFOLIO AT A GLANCE

Selected work.(09)

Nine projects: five live websites and four GitHub repositories of AI agents and automation. Names link to each project.

01 / 09APPLICATION

Between the Tiers

A single-page site that teaches how most web applications are split into three jobs: showing information, applying business rules, and storing data. It was built for Group-03's 20-minute talk in the Database Applications and Data Warehousing course at IIFT Kakinada, and credits Hoffer, Ramesh & Topi's Modern Database Management as its source. An online shop's "Place Order" button is the running example, and a short quiz with a leaderboard lets visitors test what they learned.

02 / 09APPLICATION

Urja Kaushal

A prototype proposal for a Reliance Foundation CSR initiative that trains rural communities in Jamnagar, Gujarat, in solar installation and related livelihoods. It covers the whole path from enrolment to a certified job: learners take a 600-hour programme, trainers and assessors record practical results, and certified learners are matched to employers. The footer cites targets of 10 hubs, 6,000 beneficiaries, over 50% women and 375 MWh a year of clean solar generation. The banner states that it is a prototype using sample data only, not connected to any government or Reliance API. It was built as a Team 5 proposal for IPM 2025-30.

Open project ↗
03 / 09APPLICATION

Decision Simulator

A web version of a board presentation for a fictional IT services firm, ABC Technology Services, that wants to move from legacy IT services to an AI-enabled, data- driven digital business. Instead of reading slides, a director can change the plan's levers and watch the cost, payback and migration outcomes recalculate. The proposal asks the board for a ₹25 Cr investment over 3 years (36 months, four stages from Assess to Optimise), with migration in 3 waves under a 5Rs framework and four decisions needed on the day. All figures are labelled illustrative.

Open project ↗
04 / 09APPLICATION

LEXIS

LEXIS lets anyone paste a Terms & Conditions or Privacy Policy and get a plain-English breakdown of what they are agreeing to, in under a minute. Its headline is "Stop clicking Accept blindly." It flags risky clauses, gives an overall risk score, and lists questions worth asking before agreeing. The footer states that it gives educational summaries only and is not legal advice.

Open project ↗
05 / 09APPLICATION

SOP Builder

A tool that turns messy process knowledge, such as meeting notes, chat transcripts or rough workflow outlines, into a clear standard operating procedure. A paragraph like "every Monday Sarah pastes the weekly report into Slack, Jim reviews it by noon" becomes a structured SOP with a purpose, named roles and numbered steps. The pitch is that processes should not live in people's heads, where they are lost when someone leaves.

Lead Routing Bot

Lead Routing Bot

A browser tool that shows how incoming sales leads can be scored and sent to the right salesperson, so a revenue operations team can see and test its routing logic. It is not a CRM replacement. Open one HTML file, load 15 sample leads, and see each lead's score, qualification band, assigned rep and a draft outreach email. An accompanying automation pack carries the same logic into real CRM stacks.

ASSIST
INPUT◈HUMAN
Support Reply Copilot

Support Reply Copilot

Support Reply Copilot reads a pasted customer message, works out what kind of issue it is and how urgent it is, and drafts a reply for a person to review. The design principle is "AI suggests, human decides": nothing is sent automatically, and risky messages such as billing or complaints are flagged with a "human review required" banner. It is aimed at solo founders and support teams of 1 to 10 agents.

Client Intelligence

Client Intelligence

Give the agent a company name and it researches that company, then produces a client briefing in which every claim is tied to a source, plus a reviewed outreach email. A person must approve the email before anything can be sent. The briefing includes a pitch outline, scope, discovery questions and the email. It only proposes problems and offers that the user's own service line can actually address, and it will not present a hypothesis as a fact in the email.

09 / 09AGENT & AUTOMATION
DECIDE
INPUT◈HUMAN
Document-to-Decision

Document-to-Decision

Finance teams check every invoice and contract by hand, and errors and fraud slip through. This agent reads invoices and contracts (typed text, PDFs, scans or phone photos), checks them against the company's vendor list and open purchase orders, and decides to approve, send for review, or reject. Every exception goes to a person in an exception queue. It does not pay anyone: it produces a payment file for a human to upload to net banking or the ERP.
